notes.title: 🛠️ Upcoming Update: Major Building System Expansion!
notes.content:
We’re currently hard at work on a huge overhaul of the building system in Wicked Island — one that opens the door to far more creative freedom, cozy homes, and detailed player-made environments than ever before.


While this update isn’t live yet, here’s a preview of what’s coming:
[hr][/hr]🔨 More Pieces, More Creativity
The total number of wooden build pieces is expanding to around 60, with many entirely new shapes added, from half/quarter walls to decorative beams and a lot more options for roofing. All old wood pieces have been replaced with the new visual style, making your builds feel sharper, warmer, and more cohesive.

Whether you're building a modest hut or an elaborate hillside fortress, this update aims to give you the flexibility to make it yours.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42206892/0220cf1f89fe7f8881c3c09a8e7ea126182910af.png"]
[hr][/hr]🛋️ Furniture & Decoration
A big part of this update is about making your home feel lived-in and personal. In totalt there will be over 20 furniture items and 18 decorative props, everything from more storage options, statues, banners, lighting and clutter decorations.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42206892/a150c57edb062aa724aa695d2481623da2ca7282.png"]Note: storage furniture is functional, but most new props are purely decorative.

You’ll finally be able to turn your builds into true homes, not just empty halls.
[hr][/hr]⚙️ Improved Build Experience
The build system itself has been tweaked with better snapping, quality-of-life fixes, and several key improvements:

You can now toggle placing items without collision, ideal for fine-tuning decorations.

Fixes for deleting pieces and other minor bugs that previously caused frustration and sometimes even crashes.

Snapping and placement logic has been tuned to make construction smoother overall.

Our goal is to make building as effortless as possible.
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Early Access Update + Huge Thank You!
notes.content:
First off — thank you all so much for the overwhelming support during our Early Access launch weekend.
In just a few days, over 15,000 copies of Wicked Island have been sold! That’s incredible for a wild little project like this, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the feedback, bug reports, and community energy pouring in from all directions.

This is just the beginning. The game will keep evolving based on your input — and today we’re rolling out the first update!

⚔️ Patch Notes – Version 25.08.25
➕ Added



 Pause Animation Toggle in character creator (great for getting that perfect pose!)


 Mysterious Locked Chests have appeared… what might they hold?


 Glow Effect added to unique items in the world to make them easier to spot (e.g. collectible cards)


 Skeleton Key item added (only accessible via cheat menu for now)



🔄 Changed



 Maximus' Wrath Mask no longer uses physics — no more falling down stairs or hiding in corners


 Crafting Branches: 1 wood now gives 3 branches


 Enemy Attack Timing adjusted: longer windups to give you time to react


 Armor Insulation Removed — now replaced by craftable heat/cold resistance potions


 Isabell’s Quest Reward updated: she now gives the Fleshrend Staff instead of the Punisher Sword



🛠️ Fixed



 Links in the main menu not working properly


 Isabell getting the player’s tattoos (awkward)


 Isabell's body shape not applying correctly


 Presets applying tattoos when equipped with Fleshmark Staff 

 Breast size resetting during pregnancy


 Enemies interrupting their own attacks prematurely


 Missing XP gain after birth (Birth Skill)


 Missing XP gain after taming servants


 Foliage that spawned underwater


 Some armor equip/unequip bugs that may have caused visual glitches



🚀 Performance



 Optimized texture resolutions and cleaned up unused references


 Adjusted cull distances on several meshes


 Reduced ocean/lake mesh density for improved FPS

notes.title: Wicked Island Demo 0.8.6.1 Update
notes.content:
🥊 New Struggle System — Replaces grit and difficulty points. Struggle difficulty now scales with enemy level.
🧷 Removed Difficulty Point System — Cleaner, level-based scaling across enemies and encounters.
🎨 Custom Tattoo Support — Drop your own tattoo PNGs into the game. Full mod support with a sample included.
🧰 UI Overhaul — Numerous UI improvements: hotbar fixes, better tooltips, cleaner icons, smoother sliders, and improved censorship.
🌫️ Improved Fog Rendering — New fog system for more realistic and atmospheric visuals with low performance cost.
🧠 Smarter Enemies — Better detection, new behavior based on level, improved animations and responsiveness.
🎴 Card Visual Tweaks — Updated card text and UI visuals.
🧪 Temperature System Update — Armor now affects heat/cold debuffs.
🔮 Fleshmark Staff (Cheat Menu) — Apply character presets to slaves instantly.
💋 Lewd Luring Minigame — New masturbation-based scene trigger tied to enemy level.
⚙️ Performance Boosts — Shader and texture optimizations and mesh cleanup = better performance + lower memory usage.

notes.title: Wicked Island Demo 0.8.5.9 Update
notes.content:
⚔️ Performance & Gameplay Improvements! ⚔️
    
This update brings new survival mechanics, combat tweaks, major performance optimizations, and bug fixes. Here are the biggest highlights:


    
        🍖 Survival Mode (Optional)
        
A new survival system has been added! Hunger and sleep needs now impact your gameplay, adding an extra layer of challenge. If survival mechanics aren’t your thing, don’t worry—this feature is fully optional and can be toggled in settings.

    

    
        🛠️ Major Servant System Improvements
        
The servant system has received a massive stability upgrade. While there may still be minor issues, the system is now far more reliable.

    

    
        🎨 Performance & Visual Overhaul
        
            Big FPS improvements with optimized textures, icons, and foliage.
            New volumetric fog effects (enabled by default, but toggleable).
            Upgraded water system for better visuals & performance.
            Expanded forests & improved landscapes for a more immersive world.
        
    

    📜 Full Changelog

    🆕 Added
    
        Survival mode (hunger/sleep debuffs, optional).
        Physics animations for wings/tails on various enemies.
        New melee attacks for the Dragon when grounded.
        Basic controller support (movement & combat).
        Option to keep inventory on death in settings.
        A new unique spear and steel axe/pickaxe items.
        Clothes on slaves & 13 new tattoos.
        A reaper animation.
        Censor box added to satyr and demonic statues (when censorship is enabled).
    

    🔄 Changed
    
        Increased ogre power attack animation speed.
        Pregnancy effects made harsher.
        Night spawns and ambushes now scale dynamically based on player level.
        Reduced loot and collectible drops but made leather more reliable.
        Slowed player attack speed to feel more deliberate.
        Volumetric fog now enabled by default (toggleable in settings).
    

    🐞 Fixed
    
        Player sometimes staying in downed state after respawning.
        Dragon should no longer get stuck moving only backwards.
        Fixed swimming issues in lakes.
        Enemy duplication issue on game load (hopefully fixed for the last time now).
        Neutral creatures no longer prevent saving, sleeping, or trigger combat music.
        Power attacks now work properly.
    

    🚀 Performance Enhancements
    
        Optimized foliage & prop textures for a major FPS boost.
        Upgraded tree LODs for better visuals & performance.
        Upgraded water system (possible FPS improvement).
    

    
This update focuses on major performance improvements, survival mechanics, and important bug fixes. Let us know your thoughts, and keep reporting any issues! 🚀🔥

notes.title: Wicked Island Demo Major Update
notes.content:
🌴 Wicked Island Demo Major Update 🌟
We’re thrilled to announce that the Wicked Island demo is now up to the same level as the full game available on SubscribeStar! This update brings a wealth of features, fixes, and improvements to the demo, giving everyone a chance to experience the latest version of the game. Here’s what you can expect:
🆕 Exciting Additions  First-Person Mode 🎥: Explore the island from a whole new perspective with a simple toggle.  Revamped Character Creation 🎨: Tons of new head and body presets, glowing tattoos, facial details, and more customization options!  Cheat Menu Overhaul 🔧: Now includes search functionality, JSON preset saving/loading, and loads of new features.  Pregnancy Customization 🤰: Optional settings to keep pregnancy belly and breasts growing with each pregnancy.  Combat Upgrades: Dash and power attacks now use action points, generated from hits on enemies.⚔️ Enhanced Gameplay Systems  Combat Tweaks:          Increased multipliers for power attacks (3.5x) and dash attacks (2.5x).      Small pushback added to melee strikes for more impact.        Harvesting Overhaul 🌾:          Trees, rocks, and ores behave more realistically and now shrink or split when harvested.      Improved respawn logic avoids resource nodes near player-built structures.      Cutting trees can now spawn branches.        Follower AI Improvements 🛡️:          Servants now follow and fight more reliably.      Added commands to move, attack, and stop, giving you greater control.      Fixed teleportation bugs and distractions—no more aimless wandering!      🌟 Revamped Systems and UI  Improved Locomotion: A new skeleton for the female character leads to smoother animations and better armor alignment.  Main Menu Updates: See your saved character’s armor in the menu and enjoy a cleaner layout.  Graphics Settings: Expanded options for foliage, textures, reflections, and more.🐛 Bug Fixes  Fixed low-res textures, hair color inconsistencies, and clipping issues.  Resolved major follower issues, including hostility and duplication on load.  Fixed dialogue, loot, and animation glitches, improving overall polish.  Addressed misaligned weapons, disappearing trees, and overburdened movement quirks.🚀 Performance Enhancements  Optimized LODs for female characters, armors, and distant objects.  Reduced CPU load with a revamped foliage system and smarter instancing.  Significant improvements to building, crafting, and overall world responsiveness.
This update reflects major under-the-hood changes and loads of polish to make the demo feel more immersive and rewarding. Whether you’re diving in for the first time or returning to see what’s new, we can’t wait to hear your feedback!

Thank you for your support, and happy exploring! 🌴
